title: The Kindly Harvest
author: Rosalind Villalobos
blurb: Yara Sandoval, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
